<!-- pr-reviewer: d1d0e644fce7b099f7604b9cc4ef4088281891e8 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #595, which this is stacked on; the diff against main also carries #585's `Columns::of_grid` commit 2fbe362b, as the body says).

**What looks good**
- The four readers (`prior_top` top_stock.rs, `revolved_surface` drill_prior.rs, `columns_reach` carried_stock.rs, `carried_body_bounds` across.rs) keep their formulas, same lattice origin/cell, same `floor/ceil/clamp/min` span math, same NaN-top handling (`prior_top` and `revolved_surface` return None, `columns_reach` returns true = reaches, `carried_body_bounds` skips non-finite as before). No reader acquits more than before.
- Out-of-grid handling is identical: `Columns::col` is `Dexel::col` with the same comparisons. One difference: a NaN query point now returns None where `Dexel::col` fell through to cell 0. It is not reachable here (every caller guards `q`/`c` finite first, e.g. prior.rs and drill_prior.rs), and None is the conservative direction (unknown prior = raw stock), so it cannot hide a gouge.
- `Columns::top_at(ix, iy)` adds only an in-range guard returning NaN (which every caller already treats as unknown); `Source::Grid` indexes `ix + iy*nx` exactly as before. No unwrap/expect/panic added.
- The test-only `Dexel` import is `#[cfg(test)]`; provenance line on the new `prior_columns` suite; decision file present; Changelog: none; `Refs` only.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, trial merge clean)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --no-run` | built |
| app `--lib` | 101 passed |
| app carried_verify / carried_fixtures_cache | 8 / 6 passed |
| app drill_prior / drill_prior_kinds / drill_reach / drill_reach_fit / drill_rplane | 12 / 4 / 6 / 3 / 8 passed |
| app rest_across_setups / setup_carry / suppressed_rest / top_stock | 7 / 9 / 2 / 4 passed |
| app drilling_cross_stock / lathe_cross_drill | 8 / 5 passed |
| sim `--lib` | 65 passed |
| sim prior_columns / stock_columns | 2 / 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

I did not re-run the full suites (not the 1850 total claimed); all suites covering the touched modules above passed, 0 failed.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `generate.rs` (3204 lines) and `carried_stock.rs` already exceed 400 lines; this PR adds 2 lines to generate.rs. No growth worth blocking.
- top_stock.rs puts the `prior_top_grid` helper before `use super::*;` inside `mod tests`; works, just ordering.
- The one-line `columns_reach(&crate::stock_sim::Columns::of_grid(g), ...)` call is long; rustfmt may want a wrap.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
